findings.description: Unsafe string copies using strcpy into fixed-size buffers (name, surname, city).
Incorrect calculation of buffer size. delimiter[2] cannot store a 2-character string plus the NUL terminator.
Potential NULL pointer dereferences (no checks on chunk, iterator, or record pointers).
Unchecked return values for file operations (HP_CreateFile, HP_OpenFile).
Insufficient bounds validation on indices vs actual array capacity (recordsInChunk vs records array).
